_description: Plan 026R §H.1 — operator-grandfathered exception list for tests that read aria_kernel source files as part of their assertion strategy. New tests on this list are FORBIDDEN; migration off the list happens per-phase as behavioral / AST-backed replacements land. The AST invariant at tests/test_source_marker_invariant.py reads this file at gate time.

allowed_replacements: BEHAVIORAL: exercise the kernel surface + assert observable side effects (governance event row, ledger state, return shape)
AST-BACKED: import + ast.parse + assert specific AST node shape (already done by *_invariant.py tests)
ALLOWED OUTSIDE EXCEPTION: source file reads of markdown docs, JSONL ledgers, runtime artifacts, golden fixtures, behavioral subprocess output
_policy.addition_policy: Adding a file to this list requires operator approval + an entry in the rationale section + an exit deadline (or a permanent rationale).

exceptions.rationale: Already AST-backed: parses ledger.py with ast.parse to validate lock-requirements SSoT shape. Uses read_text() to load the file for ast.parse, NOT as substring assertion. Permanent — this IS an AST invariant test by design.
AST-backed invariant: walks ast nodes searching for bare 'except json.JSONDecodeError: continue' patterns. Permanent — invariant test by design.

PLAN_020_WRITE_SURFACES constant validation — reads runtime_profile.py to verify the constant remains in sync with kernel write surfaces. The assertions check membership of a constant, not behavioral substrings. Permanent (constant invariant).

Plan 026R §A.3 migration verification: reads cycle.py + reflection.py + spine_orchestrator.py + validation_matrix_gate.py to verify legacy `load_jsonl` / `for ... continue` callsites are migrated to strict readers. This was the SOLE delivery proof for §A.3 — behavioral replacement requires injecting a corrupted ledger row at each callsite, which is multi-day work. Tracked migration; conversion target 2026-Q3.

Plan 022 spine status whitelist enforcement: reads spine_orchestrator.py + tool_runner.py to verify the closed enum of permitted run statuses + the spine_orchestrator_unknown_run_status raise wiring. Behavioral conversion requires constructing a tool envelope that emits each forbidden status — operator-approved migration deferred until Plan 030 (status enum closure phase).

Two source-marker assertions verify the in-lock recheck + already-persisted short-circuit shape in agent_invocations.py. Behavioral conversion requires a concurrent-claim torture harness — operator-approved migration to follow when Plan 023 §G concurrent-claim invariant suite lands.

_legacy_pre_invariant_files: Tests added BEFORE Plan 026R §H.1 may carry latent source-marker patterns not yet on the exception list above. The invariant fails FRESH violations only; pre-existing files remain on the migration backlog tracked by the orchestrator's reflection daily report. Document tracking in docs/plans/2026/plan-026R.md §H.1 migration appendix.
